correctness.rationale: For every integer n>=3 and arc split a+b=2n-2, conditioning on one chord leaves a uniform perfect matching. Direct pairing indicator moments give Var(Y)=2ab(a-1)(b-1)/[(M-3)(M-1)^2]. Summing the prescribed straddling-edge conditional crossing count over u in A,v in B gives the crucial Cov(X,Y)=ab(a-1)(b-1)/[6(M-3)(M-1)]. Together with Flajolet--Noy Var(X)=(n-1)(n-2)(n+2)/45, this proves the boxed conditional variance. Its inflation is nonnegative, vanishes iff min(a,b)<=1 and is uniquely greatest at a=b=n-1; finite-sum ratio gives strict interior ascent. Independently enumerated every conditional matching and exact rational X,Y moments for n=3,4,5,6 and every possible arc gap: all covariance and variance identities matched; enumeration is only corroboration.
